notes: Known bug catalogue (Part 2 + Part 3, merged into one shape) plus process/scope risk patterns. A flag fires when any of its triggers match: keywords in the brief, an identified component, the detected work type, or a named condition evaluated by the engine.

hardBlocks.label: No target page URL or path supplied
hardBlocks.detail: Nothing in the brief identifies which page this applies to, so the work cannot be located in the CMS.
hardBlocks.question: What's the target page URL or AEM/Tridion path this applies to?

hardBlocks.label: No component identified
hardBlocks.detail: The brief does not name or imply any component, so there is nothing concrete to author or fix.
hardBlocks.question: Which component does this affect — Hero, Text Block, Accordion, EXF, Image, or something else?

hardBlocks.label: Bug raised with no steps to reproduce
hardBlocks.detail: A defect cannot be triaged or assigned a severity without a reproduction path.
hardBlocks.question: What are the exact steps to reproduce this — page URL, what you clicked, and what happened?

hardBlocks.label: Bug raised with no environment
hardBlocks.detail: Severity and release impact depend on which tier the defect is on — a PROD defect is a release gate, a DEV one is not.
hardBlocks.question: Which environment is this on — DEV, QA, PRE-PROD, or PROD?

hardBlocks.label: S1 defect — P1 Hard Block
hardBlocks.detail: Any S1 automatically blocks release sign-off regardless of the completeness score.
hardBlocks.question: Confirm the S1 is fixed and re-verified before this goes to sign-off.

hardBlocks.label: CMS platform not determined
hardBlocks.detail: Execution steps are CMS-specific and cannot be generated until the platform is known.
hardBlocks.question: Is this on AEM or Tridion?

flags.label: Accordion text fails to save on PROD
flags.workaround: Delete and re-create the accordion component rather than editing in place.

flags.label: RTE anchor links break on multi-region rollout
flags.workaround: Use the Container Anchor ID field instead of anchors embedded in RTE HTML — AEM cannot rewrite URLs inside raw HTML strings during rollout.

flags.label: PNG + Smart Crop returns an invalid crop region error
flags.workaround: Use JPG or WebP for any asset that goes through Smart Crop / Dynamic Media.

flags.label: Raw /content/ path leaking into published HTML
flags.workaround: Rebuild the link with Path Picker; never paste absolute author URLs.

flags.label: Author domain URL risk on internal links
flags.workaround: Set every internal link through Path Picker so a relative /content path is stored.

flags.label: Child EXFs are not published by a folder publish
flags.workaround: Select and publish each child EXF individually — publishing the parent folder silently skips them.

flags.label: Async rollout collision on concurrent jobs
flags.workaround: Wait 20–60s for the parent rollout job to finish before triggering the child rollout.

flags.label: Un-translated navigation labels on regional sites
flags.workaround: After a Master EN rollout, check each non-English market for English strings left in the nav.

flags.label: Matrushka navigation needs L1 and L2 validated separately
flags.workaround: Validate Level 1 (Link vs Label) and Level 2 sub-links/drawers as separate cases — a working L1 says nothing about L2.

flags.label: Breadcrumb mismatch after migration
flags.workaround: Verify the page's parent/child position in the AEM Sites tree after the move.

flags.label: Duplicate rows in the migration/retrofitting sheet
flags.workaround: Audit the retrofitting spreadsheet for duplicate rows before executing — duplicates create the wrong page.

flags.label: Accented characters in Anchor IDs break URL encoding
flags.workaround: Use plain ASCII anchor IDs only — no é, à, ü, ñ.

flags.label: Hardcoded UI label is not translatable
flags.workaround: Escalate to Dev for context-aware localization config — an author cannot fix a hardcoded string.

flags.label: Structure Group may not exist in the child publication
flags.workaround: Create the Structure Group in the child publication before localizing — if it is missing the page is simply invisible, with no error shown.

flags.label: Live Copy inheritance needs validating
flags.workaround: Confirm whether the target page is part of a Blueprint chain before editing — a local edit may be overwritten by the next rollout.

flags.label: Pipe-delimited table content needs conversion to inline HTML
flags.workaround: Convert to the inline-styled table standard (border-collapse, width 100%, styled thead) and paste via RTF source view.

flags.label: nofollow on an internal service/tool link kills link equity
flags.workaround: Remove the nofollow attribute — internal service and tool pages must never carry it.

flags.label: Query-string variants must be fixed at template level
flags.workaround: ?custom-tag= / ?persona= pages are not separate pages — apply a template-level noindex rather than editing per URL.

flags.label: Canonical URL must be verified against the SEO mapping sheet
flags.workaround: Confirm the canonical matches the published live URL, not an author or legacy path.

flags.label: Missing H1 is a P1 Hard Block
flags.workaround: Add a Title Header XL component. A page published without an H1 blocks release.

flags.label: H1 must differ from the Page Properties Title
flags.workaround: Page Title is 10–60 chars for SERP; the H1 is the on-page heading. They must not be the same string.

flags.label: Dispatcher cache will mask the change during validation
flags.workaround: Validate live URLs in Incognito/private mode to bypass the CDN cache.

flags.label: Multi-Market-in-Single-Ticket — breaches One-Ticket-Per-Market
flags.workaround: Split into one ticket per country market before execution. This brief should not be worked as a single unit.

flags.label: Approval SLA risk — no named approver
flags.workaround: Name an approver per market. The 3-day SLA cannot start, and auto-escalation cannot trigger, without one.

flags.label: Campaign horizon may be under the 4–6 week minimum
flags.workaround: Global campaigns need 4–6 weeks of advance visibility for markets to prepare — confirm the launch date allows it.

flags.label: Change targets PROD directly
flags.workaround: Confirm the change has been validated on a lower tier first — DEV→QA needs zero S1/S2, QA→PRE-PROD needs UAT sign-off.
